title: Simultaneous improvement in strength and ductility of 3D-printed refractory high-entropy alloys by addition of molybdenum
process_description: prepared by electrode induction melting gas atomization (EIGA) to produce spherical powders, then fabricated using a 4 kW LAM system with a 3 mm laser beam in an Ar protective atmosphere with laser power: 1400 W, scanning speed: 10 mm/s, and powder feed rate ranging from 10 g/min to 12.5 g/min
